reply.text: Shredding down is really a nutrition and consistency game more than a program tweak — getting lean and keeping the lifts up at the same time. The app builds that side out for you: head to the Targets screen and it'll set calorie and macro targets off your weight, activity, and goal, and Meal Plan can build the eating side around that. On my end, I'll keep your training dialed in so you hold onto strength while the weight comes down — if you want to look at what you're running now or tighten anything up, say the word.
